description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy percentages for two benchmarks, MMAU and MMAR, across three model categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories (left to right): an unlabeled first category (no visible x-axis text under the first group), “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows a pair of adjacent bars: a blue bar for “MMAU” and a purple bar for “MMAR,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. In the first (unlabeled) group, the MMAU bar is approximately 49% and the MMAR bar is approximately 30%; for “Audio-Reasoner,” MMAU is about 61% and MMAR about 36%; for “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” MMAU is about 65% and MMAR about 56%. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), there are no visible error bars or annotations, and the categories appear in a fixed left-to-right order rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
